map.由年生存概率 pₓ 直接得死亡率 qₓ。: Get mortality qₓ directly from annual survival pₓ.
map.qₓ = 1−0.99 = 0.01。即该岁年死亡率 1%。: qₓ = 1-0.99 = 0.01. That is, the annual mortality at that age is 1%.
map.是。一年期 qₓ = 1−pₓ 严格成立；多年期才需用生存概率连乘。: Yes. One-year qₓ = 1-pₓ holds exactly; multi-year needs survival probabilities multiplied.
map.粗死亡率和精算死亡率能混用吗？: Can crude and actuarial mortality be mixed?
map.不能。粗死亡率来自人口统计未分年龄性别，精算死亡率按年龄、性别、吸烟等多维分层（: No. Crude mortality comes from population statistics without age/sex split; actuarial mortality is stratified by age, sex, smoking, etc. (life table). Mixing them biases pricing by tens of basis points.
map.死亡率与生存概率（本页代码口径，p 为 0–1 小数输入）：年死亡率 q=1−p: Mortality and survival probability (code basis on this page, p entered as a 0–1 decimal): annual death rate q = 1−p; n-year survival probability = p^n; probability of dying within n years = 1−p^n; linked values: expected years of survival = 1÷q, median survival years = ln0.5÷ln p. Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: no fixed grading; the first three are shown as percentages and the last two as years, and a larger q makes survival probability decay faster.
